title: Unexpected Ally
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's words were like a key, opening Chen Ji's most hidden desires—but the price of this key was that he must step deeper into the chess game.

text.content: The crescent moon hung like a hook, the mountain wind of the secret realm carrying the stench of rotting spiritual plants. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, his fingertips stroking the ancient Jade Slip—the only clue left by Chen Nian before she disappeared. The characters on the slip were as faint as a candle in the wind, yet clearly carved three words: 'Do Not Seek Me.' He tucked the slip into his sleeve, a cold glint flickering across his gaze that no one else could perceive.

The seven-day deadline had arrived. Chen Ji was not worried that Ye Qing would break her promise—although the Demonic Path followers were enigmatic in their actions, they valued commitments most. Since she said she would come, she would never go back on her word. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing toward the distant Demonic Path camp, its lights flickering dimly with occasional eerie black mist rising. If others saw a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple standing alone at the edge of the secret realm at night, it would surely arouse countless speculations.

dialogue.content: "You're quite punctual." A cold female voice emerged from the black mist, and Ye Qing in her black dress stepped through the fog, the demonic energy around her writhing like a living thing. Her face was pale as paper, yet her lips curled with a hint of mockery. "Chen Ji, do you know that just now was the perfect moment if I wanted to kill you?"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around, his face breaking into that usual timid smile: "Ye Shengnv is joking. How could a lowly Servant Disciple like me be worth your personal attention?" His tone was excessively humble, but his spine stood perfectly straight. Ye Qing narrowed her eyes, her scrutinizing gaze like that of a predator: "A Servant Disciple? I'd like to know how a Servant Disciple got his hands on a Tianji Record Fragment."

The spiritual mist in the secret realm grew denser, and the atmosphere between the two froze like ice. Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding the flash of sharp intelligence in his gaze—she was indeed probing. The existence of the Tianji Record was his trump card, something that must never be easily revealed. He feigned panic and stepped back: "What does Ye Shengnv mean? How would a lowly one like me understand anything about the Tianji..."

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's probing, Chen Ji chooses:

choices.text: Continue pretending to be a fool
choices.description: Maintain the useless persona, let her reveal more cards first

text.content: Ye Qing snorted coldly: "Keep pretending." She raised her hand, and the demonic energy at her fingertips suddenly exploded, leaving a deep gash visible to the bone at Chen Ji's feet. "I remember everything you foresaw seven days ago. If you keep pretending, I'll tear down your 'useless' persona for the entire Tianqing Sect to see."

choices.description: Admit to having the Fragment, but not reveal specific abilities
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the trump card
choices.risk_hint: May have more information extracted from him

text.content: Chen Ji's timid expression gradually faded, replaced by a faint smile: "Ye Shengnv is indeed straightforward. Yes, I do possess a Tianji Record Fragment—but its price is far heavier than you imagine." His gaze met Ye Qing's calmly. "For us to cooperate, it must be建立在平等的基础上."

choices.description: Directly point out her situation under Holy Sect control, regain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If judgment is wrong, will lose this ally

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, that laughter sounding especially harsh in the silent night: "Ye Shengnv, we both know why you came to cooperate with me—not because of trust, but because of the Soul-Devouring Gu the Holy Sect planted in your body." Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply, the demonic energy at her fingertips trembling violently. "How do you know..." Chen Ji said calmly: "I know far more than you imagine."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, the demonic energy around her slowly subsiding. She stared at Chen Ji, her gaze gaining more scrutiny and wariness: "You're more troublesome than I anticipated." She took out a black Jade Slip. "This contains intelligence on the Demonic Path commander—the Blood Slaughter Venerable, as well as... some weaknesses of the Heavenly Eye. If you want to cooperate with me, this is my sincerity."

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, his divine sense probing into it. In an instant, countless pieces of information flooded his mind—the Blood Slaughter Venerable, a peak Void Transformation realm expert commanding thirty percent of the Demonic Path's elite forces; and the Heavenly Eye was actually some kind of... consciousness entity? His brow furrowed slightly. According to the slip, the Heavenly Eye was not a physical entity, but fragments of some will scattered throughout heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye is everywhere, yet leaves no trace." Ye Qing's voice lowered. "Every generation of prophets has been watched by it. The Tianji Record is merely one of its chess pieces. I don't know why it chose you, but I know—" She paused, a complex light flickering in her eyes. "It is definitely not a friend."

choice.prompt: Regarding the cooperation method for intelligence sharing, Chen Ji decides:

choices.description: Each side gets what it needs, intelligence exchanged equally
choices.visible_cost: Need to reveal part of his own intelligence

dialogue.content: "Fair." Ye Qing nodded. "You give me three pieces of content foreseen by the Tianji Record, I'll give you three pieces of Demonic Path core secrets. But there's one condition—" Her gaze sharpened like a blade. "Regarding your sister Chen Nian, you must tell me yourself. I have leads on her."

choices.description: Only accept her intelligence, refuse to reveal his own information

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's expression darkened: "Chen Ji, I came with sincerity, yet you only want to get something for nothing?" Her demonic energy surged again. "I admit you have some ability, but this world doesn't have only you who can foresee the future. If you don't want to cooperate, you can leave now."

choices.description: Provide part of the Tianji Record's general ability information, hide key usage
choices.visible_cost: Need careful selection of what to reveal
choices.visible_reward: Build trust while protecting core secrets
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may detect the concealment

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stared at him for a long while, then suddenly laughed lightly: "You're quite cautious." She didn't press further, just pushed the black Jade Slip toward him. "Fine, take these intelligence pieces first. But remember—cooperation is two-way. What you owe me, you'll repay eventually."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, his gaze fixed on Ye Qing's face: "The seven-day agreement, our cooperation is officially formed today. However..." He shifted topics, his voice suddenly growing cold. "Ye Shengnv, you mentioned having leads on Chen Nian?" He stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes. "Speak."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing slightly raised her brow, seemingly not expecting him to be so direct. She fell silent for a moment, the demonic energy around her suddenly churning violently, then—a blood-stained jade token flew from her sleeve, landing steadily in Chen Ji's palm. On the back of the token was carved a symbol, the unique bloodline mark of the Chen Family.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly. The blood on the token had dried, but that familiar mark burned his pupils like a branding iron. This was Chen Nian's personal item—he recognized it because there was a tiny nick on the corner of the token, made by him when he was a child by accident. He took a deep breath: "Where is she?"

dialogue.content: "The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, the Abyssal Depths of Xuanming." Ye Qing spoke slowly, each word distinct. "There lies sealed a fragment of an ancient heavenly will's remnant soul. Your sister is imprisoned at the deepest point, on the 'Heavenly Fate Altar,' as a... living sacrifice." She paused. "Every full moon night, the Holy Sect extracts a strand of her Heavenly Fate power."

text.content: The hand Chen Ji held the jade token with suddenly clenched tightly, his knuckles cracking. His face showed no emotional fluctuation, but his left hand hidden in his sleeve had already formed a fist, his fingernails deeply embedded in his palm. He knew too well what Chen Nian meant to him—the only blood relative in this world, the only weakness he had while disguised as atrash.

Ye Qing watched him quietly, seemingly waiting for his reaction. After a moment, she continued: "I can tell you how to enter the Abyssal Depths of Xuanming, even help create an opportunity for you to escape. But the price is—" Her gaze sharpened. "You must help me remove the Soul-Devouring Gu in my body."

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's trade condition, Chen Ji:

choices.description: Cannot delay regarding sister's matters, must act quickly
choices.visible_cost: Will need to spend Heavenly Fate to remove her Gu
choices.risk_hint: Consuming Heavenly Fate will weaken foresight ability

text.content: "Deal." Chen Ji didn't hesitate for a moment. "I'll find a way to solve the Soul-Devouring Gu issue. But regarding Chen Nian—if you're lying to me..." He didn't finish, yet the coldness in that flat tone made even Ye Qing pause slightly. "Very well." Ye Qing said softly, a complex light flickering in her eyes. "You're indeed not an ordinary person."

choices.description: First confirm she's telling the truth, then discuss conditions
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may be dissatisfied at being questioned

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's expression slightly darkened: "You don't trust me?" Chen Ji shook his head: "Not distrust, but must confirm." He took out Chen Nian's Jade Slip from his sleeve. "I need to use the Tianji Record to verify what you said—don't worry, just a 'glance,' won't consume too much." He paused. "This is the foundation of cooperation, isn't it?"

choices.description: Agree to cooperate, but secretly arrange insurance
choices.visible_cost: Need more energy to balance both sides' relationship
choices.visible_reward: Have a retreat path even if Ye Qing turns hostile
choices.risk_hint: If discovered may completely lose ally

text.content: "Good." Chen Ji nodded, a subtle arc curling at the corner of his lips. He pretended to ponder for a moment, while secretly activating the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve, peering into Ye Qing's possible actions in the next two hours—all善意. He withdrew his divine sense and said calmly: "Deal. Before the next secret realm opens, I'll solve the Soul-Devouring Gu problem for you."

Ye Qing gazed at his calm expression, then suddenly laughed softly: "Chen Ji, you know what? I originally thought you were just a luckytrash." Her gaze became profound. "Now I see, I was wrong. You are the... most dangerous chess player in this chaotic world." Chen Ji gave no answer, just tucked both the Jade Slip and jade token into his chest, turning to look at the distant horizon.

"Next time we meet, I'll bring detailed defensive maps of the Abyssal Depths of Xuanming." Ye Qing's voice came from behind. "As for the Soul-Devouring Gu..." She paused. "I can hold on for three months. Is that enough?" Chen Ji didn't look back: "Enough." The words fell, black mist surged, swallowing Ye Qing's figure. Silence returned to the secret realm, only the mountain wind wailing, blowing his blood-stained clothes.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, staring at the jade token in his palm, his fingertips gently stroking that familiar nick. Sister, wait for me. He pressed the token close to his heart, closing his eyes. Brother will come save you. This time, not thetrash Servant Disciple Chen Ji, but... the inheritor of the Tianji Record. He opened his eyes, cold light suddenly flashing in them. Heavenly Eye, since you dared to treat my sister as a sacrifice—then let's走着瞧.

text.content: The prohibition of the secret realm began to loosen, signaling the exit was about to open. Chen Ji took a deep breath, concealing all emotions beneath that timid mask. He walked slowly toward the gathering point, but中途忽然停住—the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve actually felt warm, as if responding to that faint sense of being watched when he mentioned the Heavenly Eye earlier. His brow furrowed slightly, yet he continued forward without changing expression.

Chen Nian, wait for me. No matter how dangerous the Abyssal Depths of Xuanming is, no matter what price I must pay, I will bring you back. This was the first time Chen Ji made such a firm promise in his heart to his sister who had been missing for years. The night faded, and the eastern horizon brightened with the first light of dawn. A new day was about to begin, and his deal with Ye Qing would completely change the chess game of this chaotic world.

When the first ray of morning light pierced through the clouds, Chen Ji had already returned to the ranks of Tianqing Sect Outer Disciples. He lowered his head, hunched his shoulders, looking completely like a胆小鬼 terrified to death. The disciples around cast contemptuous glances, whispering about the various dangers in the secret realm, but none noticed that in his sleeve, the blood-stained jade token was emitting a faint yet steadfast glow.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed幽幽 in the depths of the Tianji Record: "The chess game has been set, all pieces are moving. But Chen Ji, do you know what kind of abyss you're stepping into?" Chen Ji naturally didn't know. He only knew that his sister was waiting for him, that the deal with Ye Qing needed to be fulfilled, and that the so-called Heavenly Eye... He raised his head toward the vast sky, a cold, fierce light flickering in the depths of his eyes—he, Chen Ji, never believed in destiny.
